svg.title: Spead AI: how work flows
svg.desc: 1. Set up the workspace (Company admin): Picks the industry, uploads the first documents or uses sample documents, and sees a setup checklist. 2. Shape the organisation (Company admin): Creates units and positions, writes company rules for every assistant and links document labels to positions. 3. Approve knowledge (Knowledge manager): Reviews proposed uploads, approves them as new documents or new versions, or rejects them with a reason. 4. Ask with sources (Employee): Asks a question in AI Partner and gets an answer with numbered sources that open the document at the cited page. 5. Analyse documents (Employee): Runs a ready-made task such as compare, summarise, translate or extract to a table over chosen documents. 6. Create a document (Employee): Describes a letter, report or presentation, answers Spead's questions, approves the outline and edits the result. 7. Route and sign (Approver and signatory): Initials, approves or signs in order; the letter number is assigned at signing. 8. Watch usage (Company admin): Checks whether the monthly quota will last, who is blocked by a limit and how many people actually use Spead.
svg.text: From the first step to the last, and who does what.
